CRT conjugacy gives 2^s invariant slices. The odd-factor decorated substitution is proved primitive by a zero-modulus odd-bit digit perturbation; every base cylinder occurs at all odd-modulus phases, so its orbit closure is the entire product, proving strict ergodicity. Conditional digit balance yields prefix-sum uniformity. The packaged verifier tests finite identities; infinite conclusions rely on the written proof.

value.rationale: The complete 2-primary obstruction is a natural structural invariant of finite cyclic antiderivative extensions of a canonical primitive substitution. For each q it gives an explicit and sharp number of minimal components, their dynamics and measures, and explains the apparent paradox of uniform modular prefix-sum residues despite nonminimality. Not a routine special q=2 reproof or an arbitrary finite computation.
